name: VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026
short_description: A full-marathon event in Đồ Sơn, Hải Phòng, Vietnam, taking place on December 13, 2026, with distances ranging from 5km to 42.195km.
ai_summary: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is a full-marathon event scheduled for December 13, 2026, in Đồ Sơn, Hải Phòng, Vietnam. faqs.question: When is the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026?
faqs.answer: The VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 is scheduled to take place on December 13, 2026. The event will be held in Đồ Sơn, a coastal area of Hải Phòng, Vietnam, and is organized by VnExpress in partnership with FPT Online, offering runners a full day of racing across multiple distances.

faqs.question: What distances are offered at this race?
faqs.answer: Runners can choose from four distance options at the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026: a full marathon of 42.195km, a half marathon of 21.1km, a 10km race, and a shorter 5km race, allowing participants of varying experience levels and fitness to take part in the event.

faqs.question: Who organizes the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026?
faqs.answer: The race is organized jointly by VnExpress, a major Vietnamese news outlet, and FPT Online. Together they coordinate the event held in Đồ Sơn, Hải Phòng, Vietnam, bringing together runners for the full marathon, half marathon, 10km, and 5km distance categories on December 13, 2026.

faqs.answer: As of now, the registration status for the VnExpress Marathon Hải Phòng 2026 has not yet been announced. Prospective participants should check back for updates from the organizers, VnExpress and FPT Online, regarding sign-up dates, fees, and any other registration requirements for this Vietnam-based race.
